build.buttonHint: Shirya wurinka (B). Duk wanda ya ziyarce ka zai ga tsarinka.
build.hint: Danna don sanyawa, ko danna kaya don matsar da shi. Danna dama yana cirewa. Maɓallai: R don juyawa, E don ɗauka, Enter don sanyawa, Delete don cirewa, [ ] don sauya kaya.
build.hintCarrying: Danna inda zai tafi (ko danna Enter). R don juya shi, Delete don cire shi, Escape don mayar da shi.
build.full: Wannan shi ne iyakar kayan da wuri zai iya ɗauka. Cire ɗaya don sanya wani.
build.loadFailed: Ba a iya loda tsarinka ba. Sake gwadawa nan da ɗan lokaci.
build.announceOn: Ana ƙawata. Danna wani wuri, ko fuskance shi sannan ka danna Enter, don sanya kaya.

announce.pickedUp: An ɗauka. Ajiye shi inda zai tafi, ko danna Escape don mayar da shi.

consent.title: Adana tsarinka
consent.body: Ana adana tsarinka a asusunka na kanka, inda kowa zai iya gani, kamar rubuce-rubucenka. Hakan na buƙatar ƙarin izini ɗaya. Za ka tabbatar da shi da asusunka sannan ka dawo nan take.
